Lettuce:
sheep love lettuce.
if you put any lettuce next to a sheep, he'll eat it.
when the sheep notices a lettuce, an icon appears in the lower left screen.
use lettuce to line a path.

Fan:
The fan moves air around.
the fan spreads smells around.
the fan can propel a small boat.

metal Detector:
the metal detector is very useful in detecting traps or metal objects buried in the ground.

Every 30 seconds
I move my two sheep.
If there is one too many
or if one is missing,
i attack everything
within my zone.

Desert beach.

in the sand, thinking
they would find a coin-tree
on getting out of jail.

Jail.

two people,
and the door opens!

Inflatable Sheep:
perfect replica of a real sheep.
It acts as a decoy and can be positioned like a live sheep.
You'll have to blow it up yourself,
then jump on it to let the air out!
